correctness.rationale: The published 60 facets have f-vector (12,66,144,150,60). Contracting the 11-edge star at vertex 1 gives 55 graph-cycle coordinates. The 144 facial triangle relations have integer Smith normal form with 54 unit factors and one free coordinate, so H_1 is Z without torsion. A displayed integral cocycle annihilates every relation, maps the cycle (1,2,3) to -1, and maps all 76 nonfacial triangular cycles to unit values (30 positive, 46 negative). Every 3-cycle not bounding a triangular face is therefore a primitive shortest nonzero homology cycle. Exhaustive backtracking and full-facet preservation give 96 automorphisms, 12/48/16 carrier orbits, and a 48/48 split of their induced homology-sign action.

value.rationale: The 12-vertex neighborly triangulation of the nonorientable S3-bundle is a natural and unusually symmetric small 4-manifold. Its 76 nonfacial triples form the entire first possible layer of nontrivial simple edge loops. Determining that all are primitive integral classes, partitioning their carrier sets into exactly three symmetry orbits, and determining the nontrivial ±1 homology action provides a complete exact small-complex combinatorial-systole invariant not mechanically implied by previously tabulated H1, f-vector or group order. The result is finite but mathematically motivated and self-contained.
